orientation.note: hexagon vertices lie on the field X axis (one toward the alliance wall, one toward midfield); the two long flats are parallel to X with normals along +-Y

hubFunnel.method: All vertices of the six GE-26329 Hub Funnel Side parts of Hub<1> (baked, WPILib frame) are clustered by z (0.5 mm). Per ring: apothem = min over vertices of the hexagon norm max(|dy|, 0.866|dx|+0.5|dy|) about the funnel centre (the inner, ball-facing surface), circumradius = apothem/cos30, outerApothem = max of the same (the sheet is a few mm thick). The wall is a straight hexagonal frustum (about 60 degrees from horizontal) with small 3 in steps, so the raw 112 rings are merged into levels (12 mm) and a linear fit is given; use linearFit (or interpolate levels). rimInner is the opening seen from above (apothem 0.53 = the 41.7 in hexagon).

bumpRidge.method: Upper envelope (max z over the full 73 in bump width) of the upward-facing triangles of the six BUMP PLASTIC parts of one bump (GE-26101), sampled every 5 mm in x and simplified with Douglas-Peucker (1.5 mm). x is the offset from the bump centre (= the hub centre x); the shape is symmetric about 0 and constant in y.
